3. The agent tried to use `str_replace_editor` (without proper namespace) which failed repeatedly - it seems the agent didn't have the right editor tools.
4. The agent spent most of its time using `repo.shell` (grep, sed, cat) to search through files, but never actually wrote any code changes to the source files.

The key question is: WHY did the attempt fail?

Looking at the evidence:
- The agent tried to use `str_replace_editor` (tool calls 2, 5, 36) which failed because the tool name wasn't properly qualified with a namespace. The error was: `error=bad_tool_name fault=policy) tool name 'str_replace_editor' must be '<app>.<tool>'`

- The agent also tried `fs` at one point which also failed with the same error.
- The agent seems to have lacked the ability or knowledge to actually edit files. It could only use shell commands and read files.
